title: Fair Housing Act
source_id: 42 U.S.C. 3601 et seq. (ch. 45, subch. I); Title VIII of the Civil Rights Act of 1968, Pub. L. 90-284
verified_how: Fetched govinfo USCODE-2024 42 U.S.C. 3601. The Short Title note says the title 'may be cited as the Fair Housing Act'.
notes: The only general federal tenancy statute, and it covers discrimination in renting and sales only. Leases, deposits, rent and eviction are governed by state landlord-tenant law.
